subject: NorthSprout: premium support + custom connector — exec approval request
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: NorthSprout: premium support + custom connector — exec approval request

Team —

Quick summary: NorthSprout is ready to sign a 3-year agreement (first-year ARR $1.15M) but is requesting a bundled onboarding + premium support concession that falls outside our standard commercial guardrails. They want: 1) Premium Support included at a 30% discount to list for the first year, 2) 400 hours of onboarding/professional services bundled (our standard is 120 hours for this tier), and 3) a custom Salesforce->ClinicalConnector we estimate ~120 dev hours for.

Why this matters: NorthSprout is strategically important in oncology vertical; referenceable pilot and strong expansion upside across 2 additional product lines. Without the concession they will push to a competitor.

What I'm asking for: Executive approval to offer the following one-time exception: 25% discount on Premium Support for year 1 (instead of 30 requested), 200 hours PS included at fixed price (we absorb up to 200 hours), and include the custom connector as a capped SOW item with 80 hours included; additional hours billed T&M. This still exceeds standard policy (discount >20% and >120 included PS hours), so I need signoff to proceed.

Attachments: NorthSprout_SOW_v3.pdf (proposed SOW with scope & milestones), NorthSprout_PricingSheet.xlsx (price / margin calc).

Key risks/mitigations:
- Risk: PS overruns if scope expands. Mitigation: Timebox phases, change-order gating and a clear acceptance checklist in the SOW.
- Risk: SLA load on Support team. Mitigation: Grace confirmed we can staff the month-1 ramp and schedule a second PM for handoff.

Requested by EOD tomorrow so we can finalize DocuSign by Friday.

Thanks,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: NorthSprout_SOW_v3.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: NorthSprout_PricingSheet.xlsx (Excel)]
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: NorthSprout: premium support + custom connector — exec approval request

Rishi —

Thanks for the clear write-up. A few questions before I can sign off:
1) Can you share the expected gross margin impact (absolute $ and %) for year 1 under your proposed concession?
2) Why 200 hours included vs. the 120 standard — how did you land on that number? Is any of that work deferrable to paid professional services after go-live?
3) Are there any security or legal exceptions in SOW_Sec / T&Cs (data residency, audit logs) that would trigger legal escalation?

Please reply inline so we have a single thread for the approval record.

-Lauren
Lauren Bishop
VP, Sales Operations

To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2026 12:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: NorthSprout: premium support + custom connector — exec approval request

Lauren —

Inline answers below.

1) Margin impact (year 1):
- List revenue year 1: $1,150,000
- Proposed concessions: 25% discount on Premium Support = estimated $92k reduction; absorbing 200 PS hours (our blended rate $180/hr) = ~$36k margin we waive; including 80 connector hours = ~$14k.
- Net revenue after concessions ~ $1,008,000. Estimated gross margin hit ~ 10-12% absolute on year 1 (model attached, see PricingSheet tab).

2) Why 200 hours: their implementation includes two bespoke data mappings and an EHR-federation step that cannot be delivered without additional PS time up front. We propose to break the onboarding into Phase 1 (core rollout, 200 hours included) and Phase 2 (enhancements, chargeable at T&M). Phase 1 is required for their go-live and is what they insist on bundling. We believe that 200 hours is a fair middle ground vs their ask of 400.

3) Legal/security: No special data residency asks; legal reviewed SOW_v3 and flagged only the standard confidentiality clause. No KMS/HSM exceptions requested. I asked Legal to queue a redline check; no blocking items at this stage.

Additional context: HubSpot deal link and revenue math: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/478-NSPR/DEAL-2026-0478

If we approve this today we can route the DocuSign by Thursday and expect start of onboarding first week of Jan.

Thanks,
Rishi

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2026 15:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: NorthSprout: premium support + custom connector — exec approval request

Lauren / team —

I support Rishi's proposed concession with the conditions listed below. Quick notes from Sales perspective:
- Strategic value is high — pilot with an oncology leader, expected referenceable case studies and 2 add-on products within 18 months.
- If we don't bend here we risk losing the entire deal to competitor X; the risk of churn post-launch is low based on their pilot signals.

Conditions I recommend we attach to approval:
1) Approve up to 25% discount (year 1) on Premium Support only.
2) Approve 200 hours included PS (fixed, not to be exceeded without written change order).
3) Approve inclusion of connector with 80 hours included; any additional connector dev billed T&M.
4) Require a success milestones table in SOW that gates the start of Phase 2 paid work and defines acceptance criteria.

Grace — can you confirm your team has capacity to cover the ramp and 200 hours in Q1 (subject to start date of Jan 4)? If you need additional headcount we'll document the impact and push back on the hours included.

If Grace confirms capacity and Legal signs off on the standard SOW language, I'm +1 to execute.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Director, Enterprise Sales
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Dec 2026 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: NorthSprout: premium support + custom connector — exec approval request

Ben / team —

Confirming capacity: Support and Onboarding PMs have reviewed the SOW. We can absorb the 200 included hours in Q1 as long as the start date remains Jan 4 and we get the named-resource commitment (one Lead PM + one Support Engineer for the first 8 weeks).

I also recommend: include a clause that any scope creep triggers an estimated-change notice within 5 business days and that we hold the right to pause work pending approval of additional hours. That clause is already in SOW_v3.

Given Legal's quick redline, Ben's conditions, and the margin impact that Rishi laid out, I'm comfortable operationally with the proposed package.

If Lauren signs off we can move to DocuSign and schedule kickoff.

Grace O'Connor
Head of Customer Success
[Attachment: NorthSprout_SOW_v3.pdf (updated with milestone table)]
